List a project's snapshots

Source: R/snapshots.R
snapshot_list.Rd

Returns the project's snapshots, newest first, with their metadata and a summary of the cached totals (how many repositories had a complete total, and its mean and range).

Usage

snapshot_list(project = ".", kind = NULL, since = NULL, n = NULL)

Arguments

project

Path to the project directory. Defaults to the working directory.

kind

Optional filter: "manual" or "auto".

since

Optional lower bound on creation time (a POSIXct, Date, or a string as.POSIXct() understands).

n

Optional maximum number of snapshots to return.

Value

A data frame (class markermd_snapshot_list) with one row per snapshot: snapshot_id, created_at (in the session's time zone), created_tz, username, kind, trigger, label, summary, n_notes, pinned, n_complete, mean_total, min_total and max_total. Its print method shows one line per snapshot.

See also

snapshot_create(), snapshot_info()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
snapshot_list("hw01")
snapshot_list("hw01", kind = "manual")
} # }
